item.title: Solved: How to Check Task Status in Celery with Practical Examples
item.description: How does one effectively determine the status of a task in Celery, particularly when integrating with Django? This question often arises, particularly when you want to ensure a task (like a media transcoding job handled by an external Java service) is currently running. If not, you’ll need to initiate it again. After consulting the official Celery documentation and other resources, I found a few insightful methods worth sharing, accompanied by practical code examples tailored to your needs.
